summary: The note surveys how schools and education systems in the US, Nordic countries, Asia and elsewhere encourage parental involvement, noting that engagement improves attendance, grades and behavior. It highlights specific post-2023 initiatives for communication, active participation, support structures, language and digital equity, and community involvement. It concludes that no one-size-fits-all solution exists and strategies must fit local contexts.
one_line: Comparative survey of strategies and school-level initiatives from 2023-2024 that encourage parental involvement in education, including challenges like language, time and the digital divide.
key_facts: A Harvard University study released in October 2023 reports a positive correlation between parental engagement and academic success.
Research cited says involved parents correlate with better attendance, higher grades and improved behavior in students.
In Sweden, schools keep an open-door policy so parents can join classroom and school activities virtually unannounced, backed by societal trust and shared responsibility.
Japan and South Korea traditionally emphasize respect for teacher autonomy but are warming to parental involvement via parent-school meetings and class observation.
New Horizons Elementary School in California launched an app on January 15, 2024 for personalized teacher-parent communication, leading to a noticeable uptick in engagement.
Springfield Community School in Illinois began monthly town-hall meetings in September 2023 for rural parents to give feedback and stay informed.
Eastwood High School in New York has had parents share professional experiences at career day since November 2023.
Greenfield School District in Wisconsin invites parents to host cultural days starting in the 2023-2024 academic year.
Oasis Academy in Manchester, UK launched a Parent Partnership Program in September 2023 that assigns teacher liaisons to parents.
Melbourne Secondary College in Australia started weekend programs in February 2024 for parents in lower socio-economic communities who work multiple jobs.
The City School District of Albany in New York set up multilingual communication and interpreter services in December 2023, increasing participation of non-English speaking parents.
School District of Philadelphia has provided free internet access and devices to families in need since the start of the 2023 academic year.
Dallas Independent School District's engagement plan, started in the 2023-2024 school year, has improved student performance and parent satisfaction through ongoing measurement and adjustment.
Toronto's Community Education Program, initiated on November 10, 2023, involves parents and community members in curriculum design.
